> I too am not a bit tamed, I too am untranslatable,
I sound my barbaric yawp over the roofs of the world.
>
> -- Walt Whitman, *Leaves of Grass*

I am a Data Scientist working at State Farm on the Enterprise Experimentation team. We focus on designing experiments across the claims data science area to improve organizational knowledge and processes.

Previously, I completed my PhD under the supervision of Andreas Handel at the University of Georgia (Department of Epidemiology & Biostatistics). My main skills are R programming, study design, causal inference, and mixed-effects regression modeling. I like designing studies and leveraging statistical methods to make practical decisions, and I like communicating statistical solutions to business partners and laypeople to emphasize their value.

### Education

**PhD, Epidemiology and biostatistics.** August 2020 -- August 2025. University of Georgia, Athens, GA, USA. Area of emphasis in Data Science and Modeling.

**BS, Mathematics and biology.** August 2016 -- May 2020. Western Carolina University, Cullowhee, NC, USA.

### Interests

* (Bayesian) hierarchical/multilevel regression models
* Design of experiments and observational studies
* (In a past life) How antigenic similarity between influenza strains affects epidemiology
